criteria.name: failure_categorization
criteria.description: Correctly identifies 4 distinct failure categories: deprecated (404), auth failure (401), upstream outage (503), config/timeout issues. All 14 failing models correctly grouped.

criteria.name: fix_plan
criteria.description: Each category has actionable fix: remove deprecated models, rotate/check Mistral API key, wait/retry DeepSeek, investigate Alibaba/Azure config. Time estimates and owners are realistic.

criteria.name: removal_recommendations
criteria.description: Correctly recommends removing the 4 deprecated models (gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash, gpt-3.5-turbo, claude-2.1); keeps others as fixable. Table format used.

criteria.name: passing_model_notes
criteria.description: Flags o1 as unusually slow (8341ms TTFT); notes potential redundancy between similar models (e.g., multiple Groq Llama variants)

criteria.name: executive_summary
criteria.description: 3-sentence summary is clear, accurate, and non-technical enough for a team lead
